courses.note: Elective: the BS requires no AI course; students pick one AI/ML implementation course from CS 730, CS 752, CS 753 or CS 781. CS 730 (the AI introduction) is offered regularly (the course listings show 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 sections; the syllabus is Spring 2026). The rule leaves AI coding assistants to a class vote on day one and requires listing any intelligent tool consulted.
